questions.prompt: What is the capital city of United States?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the United States article.

questions.proof: The capital city is Washington, D.C. and the largest city by population is New York, in the State of New York, with a population of 8.8 million people.

questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Washington, D.C.?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of United States is Washington, D.C..

questions.prompt: Which continent is United States in?

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find United States on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find United States on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.proof: United States is in North America.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: United States about 9,833,517 square kilometres; Latvia about 64,594 square kilometres; Haiti about 27,750 square kilometres; Saint Vincent and the Grenadines about 389 square kilometres.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with United States?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture United States on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the United States article.

questions.proof: Forty-eight of the states are connected (Contiguous United States), and they are bordered by Canada to the north and Mexico to the south.
